name: coxagent
description: An autonomous multi-agent software team. A continuous loop of role-agents — BA → SA → PD → DEV → TEST → DOCS, with code-enforced governance — carries a ticket from proposal to a running, tested, documented build over a managed codebase. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) for the current architecture, [DEPLOYMENT.md](DEPLOYMENT.md) for the three deploy shapes (macOS app, docker-compose, Kubernetes/Helm), and [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) for the original design.
